captions.text: The Conception
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: The Christ was to spread throughout the whole world the truth of the Biblical writings, so that they would serve as proof when the era of science would explain everything to men, to the whole of humanity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators therefore decide to bring forth a child issued from a woman and from one of their own, so that the child in question would have, by heredity, certain telepathic faculties that men lack.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: she was found with child of the Holy Ghost.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Evidently Mary's betrothed, who was the chosen earthwoman, found the pill hard to swallow, but:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One of the creators comes in order to explain to him that Mary is expecting a child of God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The prophets in contact with the creators come from very far to see the divine child.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: One of the creators' flying craft serves them as a guide:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: we have seen his star rise, and are come to worship him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: and, lo, the star, which they saw rise, went before them, and came and stood over where the child was.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the creators watch over this child:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: behold, the angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Joseph, and said
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Arise, and take the child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and be thou there until I bring thee word: for Herod will seek the child to destroy him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The king looked with an unfavorable eye on this child-king come from the people into his territory, whom the prophets announced to him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At the death of King Herod, the creators warn Joseph that he can return to Israel:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At the death of Herod, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, and said: Arise, and go into Israel: for they are dead which sought the child's life.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Initiation
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: When he had reached the age of a man, Jesus was taken away by the creators in order to reveal to him who he was, to present his Father to him, to reveal to him his mission, and to initiate him into various scientific techniques.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: the heavens were opened; he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove, and coming upon him: and lo, a voice from the heavens, saying: This is my son, the beloved in whom I am well pleased.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Then was Jesus led up into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The devil, Satan, that creator of whom we spoke previously, always persuaded that nothing good can come from men: the skeptical Satan, supported by the opponents of the government of our distant planet.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Satan puts Jesus to the test in order to see whether his intelligence is positive and whether he respects and loves the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Having seen that Jesus could be trusted, he is let go so that he may accomplish his mission.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In order that the greater part of the people rally to him, he performs miracles; in reality he applies the scientific teachings lavished by the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: they brought unto him all the sick… and he healed them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Magnificent the poor by the spirit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This phrase was unjustly translated as: blessed are the poor in spirit.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The original meaning was: the poor, if they have spirit, will be happy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Nothing to do with it…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He then tells his apostles that they must spread the truth throughout the world: In the prayer called the Our Father the truth is told literally:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In heaven, on the planet of the creators, the scientists ended up reigning and created other intelligent beings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On Earth the same thing will happen.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The torch will be taken up.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This prayer, repeated by rote without understanding its deep meaning, now takes on its full significance: In earth, as it is in heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jesus had received, among other things, as teaching, how to speak with persuasion thanks to a form of group telepathic hypnosis:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When Jesus had ended this discourse, the crowds were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as their scribes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He continued to heal the sick with the help of the creators, acting at a distance by concentrated rays:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: there came a leper Jesus put forth his hand, and touched him, saying: I will; be thou purified.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And immediately he was purified of his leprosy.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The same for the paralytic.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An operation at a distance by a concentrated ray inspired by the laser but burning at only a single point through the thicknesses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Arise and walk (and) he arose.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on, in Matthew, Jesus announces what his mission is:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I am not come to call the just, but sinners.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He has not come for the people of Israel, who know of the existence of the creators, but so that this knowledge may spread throughout the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on, other miracles similar to the first ones take place.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: All on medical bases.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Nowadays the transplant of a heart, of any limb whatever, the cure of a leprosy or other illness of this kind, the coming out of a coma thanks to appropriate care, are held to be miracles by primitive tribes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: At that time men were similar to them, and the creators similar to the men of your civilized nations but yet a little more scientifically evolved.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Further on one finds an allusion to the creators, among whom is the true father of Jesus:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men, him will I confess also before my father which is in heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Before my father which is in heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Everything is said here.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is not a matter of an impalpable or immaterial God.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He is in heaven.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A thing evidently incomprehensible for beings believing the stars hung on the celestial vault like nice lights, the whole gravitating around the center of the world: the Earth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now, on the other hand, with the appearance of travels in space and the comprehension of its immensity, the texts are illuminated in a quite different way.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The Parallel Humanities
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In the Gospel according to Matthew, in chapter 13, is a capital passage where Jesus, in a parable, explains:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Behold, a sower went forth to sow.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators set out from their planet to create life on another world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: (Some seeds) fell by the way side, and the fowls devoured them up.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth; but when the sun was up they were scorched.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Some fell among thorns; and the thorns choked them…
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Others fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Who hath ears, let him hear!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: An allusion to the various attempts at the creation of life on other planets; three attempts failed: the first because of the fowls that came to devour them, in reality a failure due to the too-great proximity of that planet to the planet of origin of the creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The opponents of this creation of men similar to themselves, who saw in it a possible threat, came to destroy the creation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The second attempt was made on a planet situated too close to a too-hot sun, whose harmful radiations destroyed the creation.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The third attempt was made, on the contrary, among thorns, on a planet too humid, where the vegetable kingdom took over, destroying the equilibrium and the animal world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This purely vegetable world still exists.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Finally the fourth attempt was a success, in good ground.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And, an important thing, there were three successes, which means that on two other relatively close planets there are beings similar to men and created by the same creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Who hath ears, let him hear!: let him understand who can.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the times have come, those who seek will understand.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The others, those who look without looking and hear without hearing or understanding, those will not understand the truth.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Those who, by themselves, will have proven their intelligence and thereby that they are worthy of being helped by the creators, will be helped:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: to him that hath shall be given, and he shall have more; but from him that hath not, shall be taken away even that he hath.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The peoples that do not manage to prove their intelligence will be destroyed.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Now men have almost proven that they are worthy of being admitted by their creators as their equals; they lack… only a little love.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Love among themselves and above all toward their creators.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven….
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The three planets where life was created were put in competition.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The one where humanity will accomplish the greatest scientific progress, thus proving its intelligence, will be able to benefit from the inheritance of the creators, on condition that it does not show itself aggressive toward them; it will then receive this inheritance on the day of the last judgment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A day when a sufficient level of knowledge will have been acquired.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And the men of Earth are not very far from that time.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Human genius is the least of all seeds, but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and lodge in the branches thereof.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The birds of heaven: the creators will come to lodge in its branches, will bring their knowledge to men when they have shown themselves worthy of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A fresh allusion to the three worlds where the creators await the scientific blossoming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For this is one of the most important things: the planets have a life and one day are no longer habitable.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Man must, at that moment, have reached a sufficient scientific level to undertake either a removal to another planet, or the creation of a humanoid form of life adapted to another world, so that men survive if they cannot adapt elsewhere.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If the environment cannot adapt to men, one must create a man adapted to the environment.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: By creating, for example, before its extinction, another race of men living in a totally different atmosphere, which will inherit, before the end of the creators, the knowledge of these latter.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: So that the inheritance not be lost, the creators put life on three worlds, and only the best will have a right to the inheritance:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: at the end of the ages: the angels shall come forth, they shall sever the wicked from among the just.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The passage of the multiplication of the loaves has already been explained previously.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is a matter of concentrated foods in the form of large pills of the kind that cosmonauts use, containing all the vital principles.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Hence the hosts and their shapes recalling that of a pill.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: With the equivalent of a few loaves there is enough to feed thousands of men.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Scientific Miracles
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: When Jesus walks on the waters, the creators support him by an antigravitational ray that cancels, at a precise point, the effects of gravity.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: he went unto them, walking on the sea.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This moreover creates a turbulence which is described:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: but when saw the wind, he was afraid and when they were come into the ship, the wind ceased.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The wind ceased when they came into the ship, for the emission of the ray was interrupted when Jesus was in the ship.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Yet another quite scientific miracle.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There is no miracle, there are only gaps between civilizations.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: If you landed at the time of Jesus with a cosmic ship or even a simple helicopter, and your scientific level though limited, you would perform miracles in their eyes by making, for example, artificial light, by coming from the sky, by rolling in an automobile, watching television, or killing a bird with a rifle, for they would be incapable of understanding straightaway the mechanism that animates your machines, seeing in it a divine or supernatural force.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Tell yourselves clearly that there is the same gap between you and the men of the time of Jesus as between us and you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We can still do things that will be miracles in your eyes.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But for the most evolved among you, these will no longer be quite miracles, for you have taken the road of scientific development for some tens of years and will seek the why of things instead of stupidly putting yourselves flat on your stomachs, bringing offerings.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But our knowledge is such that you could not even glimpse, even your most eminent scientists, how we would realize these miracles if we performed them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A few particularly evolved minds might perhaps not panic, but panic would seize the crowds.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: These crowds which yet are no longer astonished by much — we still have enough to astonish them all the same.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They must now know that in any case there is no immaterial God; there are men who created other men in their image.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In chapter 17 of Matthew the creators appear once more:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: up into a high mountain apart (Jesus) was transfigured before: his face did shine as the sun, and his raiment was white as the light.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And, behold, they saw Moses and Elijah talking with him behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and, from the cloud, a voice said: This is my son, hear ye him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This scene takes place at night, and the apostles are all frightened to see Jesus lit by the powerful projectors of the flying craft from which Moses and Elijah come out, still alive thanks to the tree of life from which they have benefited.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Immortality is a scientific reality, even if it does not correspond to the idea that man makes of it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The phrase:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The first shall be last and the last shall be first means that the created will be creators as the creators were created.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: To Deserve the Inheritance
captions.speaker: Narrator

captions.text: In chapter 25 (verses 14 to 29) of the Gospel according to Matthew it is said again that the three planets must make scientific progress and that all this will be judged one day.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Hence the parable:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Setting off on a journey, a man has entrusted his goods to his three slaves:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The first received five talents;
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The second two talents;
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The third one talent.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the master returns: the first gives him back the five talents and shows him five others he has gained with them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The second gives him back the two talents plus two he has gained with them.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The third gives him back only the talent that had been handed to him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have more; but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Of the three worlds where life was created, the world that will have made the most progress will receive the inheritance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The one that will not have progressed will be dominated by the other and annihilated.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is true also on Earth among the peoples.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In chapter 26 Jesus reveals the importance of his death and of the scriptures destined, later, to bear witness: when one of his own wants to defend him with the sword he answers:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Put up again thy sword into his place.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Thinkest thou that I cannot now pray to my father, who shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled?
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For thus it must be.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jesus must indeed die, the truth must spread, so that later, when the creators return to Earth, they not be taken for usurpers or invaders.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The usefulness of the biblical and evangelical writings is that.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: It is so that the trace of their work and of their presence be kept and that they be recognized when they come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Jesus, once dead, is resurrected thanks to the help of the creators:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: there was a great shaking, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone (which closed the tomb of Jesus) and sat upon it.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators treat and revive Jesus.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And he says:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Go ye therefore (and tell all this) to all nations, make disciples of them teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The mission of Jesus comes to an end.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: after he had spoken unto them, (he) was received up into heaven The creators took him away after this last phrase, so important:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: (The times will have come when men) shall take up serpents, drink poison without being harmed by it, lay hands on the sick and make them well.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When men will know antivenom serum, antidotes, will have developed surgery, etc. — which is happening now.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators, before returning, will make appearances closer and closer together in order to prepare their coming, as is happening at this moment, in order to give brilliance to these revelations:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Behold the fig tree when the buds shoot forth, summer is not far off.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When the unidentified flying objects appear in profusion as now, it is that the times have come.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the Acts of the Apostles in chapter 2 it is said again:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: On the day of Pentecost (the apostles) were together when suddenly there came from heaven a sound as of a violent rushing wind, which filled all the house where they were sitting, and they saw tongues, as of fire, divide and rest upon each of them, and all were filled with the Holy Ghost and began to speak with other tongues….
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The creators, thanks to a condensed teaching, instilled rapidly in the form of amplified telepathic waves and applied in a form akin to electroshock, imprint in the memory of the apostles the elements of other languages.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They will thus be able to spread the truth throughout the world.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: In the Acts of the Apostles one must cite the appearances of the creators, the angels, on several occasions and notably to free Peter, chained by Herod:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And behold, an angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The angel awakened Peter, striking him on the side, and said: Arise up quickly.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The chains fell from his hands.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: The angel said unto him: Gird thyself, and bind on thy sandals; he did so.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He said again unto him: Cast thy garment about thee, and follow me.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Peter went out and followed him, not knowing that what was done by the angel was true: he thought he saw a vision.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Peter, primitive as he was, before his chains falling all by themselves, believes he is having a vision.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: He does not know the electronic laser torch one of the creators uses.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: When such fantastic things occur, one believes one is dreaming.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: This is why it is often said of those who have seen the creators that they had a vision, that they saw in a dream.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: A bit as it is often said of those who really see our flying craft that they had hallucinations.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: There, it is clearly explained that he thought he saw a dream but that it was indeed real!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: They… came unto the iron gate (which) opened of its own accord
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: immediately the angel departed from him.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Another sign that the times have come is that the people of Israel has recovered its country:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: After this I will return, and I will rebuild the tabernacle of David, which was fallen!
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: Another important phrase in a following chapter:
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: For we are also his offspring., it is said, speaking of God, by an apostle.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: We are not going to continue reading thus the rest of the Gospels, where there are still many allusions to the creators but of lesser importance.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: You will know how to translate them yourself, for those who will ask you questions, in the light of the explanations I have given you up to here.
captions.speaker: Yahweh

captions.text: And he departed as the previous times.
captions.speaker: Narrator
